lead: Awarded $5.07M (+$760K contingency) by Murrieta on Sept 1 to grind and repave about 3.8 miles of Jefferson Ave (Nutmeg St to Los Alamos Rd) and Clinton Keith Rd (west city limit to Mitchell Ave).
notes: Source: Valley News, Sept 17, 2026 (Murrieta City Council 4-0 vote Sept 1). Work is about 20 miles south of the yard. Mostly asphalt millings; they run their own plants, so ask about dumping excess AC/concrete from curb and ramp work and buying base for any base repairs.

lead: Wildomar City Council unanimously awarded a $6,883,950 street improvements construction contract on Sept 9, 2026; the winning contractor was not in the reports I could find.
notes: Source: Valley News, Sept 2026 (Wildomar City Council Sept 9). About 20 miles from the yard. Call Public Works and ask which contractor won and when work starts, then call that contractor about dumping broken AC/concrete and buying base. Wildomar also plans to repave about 140 streets and is taking Bundy Canyon Rd segment 2 to bid.

lead: Bids opened Sept 23, 2026 for the Market Street Bridge replacement over the Santa Ana River; Van Buren Blvd Resurfacing bids opened Sept 16. Low bidders for both not posted yet.
notes: Source: County of Riverside Transportation Dept notices inviting bids (bid dates Sept 16 and Sept 23, 2026). Tearing out the old bridge means a lot of broken concrete. Known plan holders already on the list: Guy F. Atkinson, Riverside Construction, Powell, Beador, Reyes, Ferreira, R.J. Noble, Romero, O'Duffy. Ask for the bid results and call the low bidder.
